text:
Maya: quick question — for the emergency fix we're queuing for the 12:30 UTC window, should we bump the patch (v1.4.2) directly or create an RC and promote?

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved by @Maya for 2024-05-05 12:30 UTC. Canary -> prod. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Chris: patch directly for true emergencies. RC adds paperwork and delays. :+1:

Samir: agree with Chris if no API/schema changes. If it's user-visible contract change, use rc then promote.

Jen: also think about our release notes automation — it expects a canonical tag `vX.Y.Z` to generate notes. RC tags currently get filtered out.

Leo: fwiw, I proposed `hotfix` suffix a while back to make the flow obvious: `v1.4.2-hotfix.1`. automation can still map it. But I know that breaks semver parsers.

Katy: prefer staying semver-compliant. Hotfix as metadata confuses tooling (packaging, backports). Keep it `v1.4.2` and append buildmeta if needed: `v1.4.2+hotfix.20240505`.

Maya: proposed rule draft: 
- emergency (security/crash/high-sev) -> bump patch `vX.Y.Z`, include `+hotfix.<id>` buildmeta and a changelog entry referencing the incident ID.
- non-emergency but pre-release (qa verified) -> create `vX.Y.Z-rc.N` and promote on green canary.

Samir: sounds reasonable. Also call out lockfile pinning: after patch tag landed, we must update the monorepo lock and push a commit to `main` that references the tag so deploys are deterministic.

Jen: example tagging commands for emergency patch:

```
# create annotated tag and push
git tag -a v1.4.2 -m "hotfix: fix memory leak (#1234)"
git push origin v1.4.2
```

Maya: and include buildmeta if CI wants to show provenance: `v1.4.2+ci.20240505.3` — tooling ignores buildmeta for semver comparison, so safe.

Leo: what about rollback heuristics? if prod is bad, we revert by creating a rollback tag that points at the last-good commit or trigger the rollback job. example: `rollback-to-v1.4.1` in the deploy bot.

Katy: prefer not inventing rollback tags. Our deploy pipeline supports `deploy-bot rollback v1.4.1` which is safer than pushing new tags.

Samir: action item: add this flow to release playbook and update the release notes generator to pick up `+hotfix` buildmeta.

Maya: I'll update the docs and put a small checklist in the deploy playbook. Draft rules: patch-for-emergency, rc-for-staged, buildmeta for provenance, don't use ad-hoc "hotfix" suffix to avoid parser issues.

Jen: +1. Also pinging @eng-sre to make sure the rollback command is battle-tested.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for v1.4.2 (author: Maya). Status: canary-running.

Chris: watching the canary. no regressions so far.

deploy-bot: Canary completed. Promoting to prod.

Katy: prod looks green. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks all — I'll land the doc updates and add a one-liner to the release checklist. :white_check_mark:
